l.i: Heu, quam immatura, subita quam morte pe-
Hinc est, pæne simul repetitis saucia plagis
Unicum tota suos adungit Gallia planctus,
Tu tua, summe Pater, rata sint promissa iubeto,
Ad qua tu nobis sanctorum salua parentum
Numine plena tuo, et cunctis virtutibus aucta,
Quos inter teneris princeps iam magnus in annis,

page.notes: Several lines at the left edge are cut off or partly illegible from the scan; the leading letters of some lines (e.g. "Heu", "Tu tua", "Ad qua", "Facsupleant") are reconstructed from context and marked as doubtful. Long s rendered as s. Ink marks and show-through in the lower half of the page are not transcribed.
